issue.title: First Ctrl+S after a fold plus programmatic refreshes is intermittently swallowed in the node-rail golden harness (masked by a retry loop)

task_type_fields.evidence:
Proposed by phase bead sase-1bn.5 (PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP #1): while generating the node-rail goldens, the first `ctrl+s` after a group fold (`H`) plus programmatic `_refresh_agents_display` calls was intermittently swallowed before any deck state changed (focus, screen, and tab all correct, no modal). The phase worked around it with a bounded 3-try retry in `_enter_rail` (tests/ace/tui/visual/test_ace_png_snapshots_agents_node_rail.py:180-198) instead of finding the root cause.

sase-1bn land agent attempt to reproduce at master 52f7351ae (single press, no retry, `action_toggle_node_panel` instrumented): the by-project scenario (fold + refreshes) 6/6 passes serial, and plain + by-status scenarios 10/10 passes under `-n 4`, so 0 failures in 22 runs; every press reached `action_toggle_node_panel` and railed. Fail rate is therefore low or harness/host-load dependent. Not shown to be caused by the rail epic: `action_toggle_node_panel` dispatch predates it.

Asks: (1) find what can drop the first `ctrl+s` (a pending key chord from `H`/`o s`, `check_action` availability during a programmatic refresh, or the `except Exception: return` in `action_toggle_node_panel` hiding a raise), (2) fix it in product code if real, and (3) then delete the retry loop so the golden asserts a single press.

issue.creation_reason: sase-1bn.5 masked an intermittent swallowed Ctrl+S in the rail goldens with a bounded retry instead of root-causing it; the land agent could not reproduce it, so it needs a dedicated investigation.

payload.description: The retry loop lives in sase-1bn.5's node-rail golden harness; the epic introduced the rail goldens
